name: NeuroSurge
source_lineage: Based on C410 with the wider view, shared brain and mirror carry, body-bounds corrections, camera hand framing, bounded display search and failure diagnostics. Existing mesh files, asset notices, public provenance redactions and desktop launchers are retained.
anatomy_assets: 490 OBJ meshes retained from the preceding preview. BodyParts3D is CC BY 4.0; Z-Anatomy facial derivatives are CC BY-SA 4.0.
public_preview_authorized: 10 November 2026 user instruction: experimental previews for all projects
browser_verification: An independent review checked 21 recorded browser states for the camera correction, including hand projection, drags, releases and switching between camera views. Longer reach-and-release tests later found a stop bug. Those failures remain open; this preview does not establish complete control, timing, joint-mechanics or physiological validation.
known_engineering_gaps: The mirror is larger on screen but still farther away in the scene
Some sideways inputs lack matching muscle glow
Near/far endpoint and regrasp coverage is incomplete
Combined-key response and latency need further checks
Complete hand-border and all-view control coverage is not verified
Releasing a grasp after sustained reaching can stop the game
publication_status: Selected for experimental publication under the user’s latest upload instruction; the known reach-and-release stop bug is disclosed.
